source.basis: Frozen local working-tree bytes, including uncommitted and untracked Region implementation changes; not a claim of pristine HEAD source.
source.copiedSourcePolicy: All selected production source, tests, consumer rules and module build files are byte-identical to the captured local origin. New release roots, reduced catalogs, notices and license-resource packaging are separately identified as release glue.
source.buildIsolation: No original checkout, filesystem dependency, submodule, included build or original SDK GitHub repository is required at build time.

toolchain.ndkVersion: Selected by AGP 9.4.1; original module metadata does not pin ndkVersion.
nativeRequirements: Android NDK C++17 toolchains and Vulkan/Android/mediandk headers/libraries
NDK shader-tools glslc host executable for KAP ktx_color.frag
JDK 17 toolchain for kap-core; Android/JVM target 11 retained elsewhere

licenses.name: BSD-3-Clause
licenses.copyright: Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. All rights reserved.

excluded: vap-vk-android/src/main/cpp/shaders/vap_seq.frag.spv (unused binary; GLSL and embedded SPIR-V headers retained)
releaseGlueChanges: Independent settings include only the 3 KAP / 7 VAP release module closure.
Catalogs omit unused dependencies without changing retained versions.
Root Maven base plugin uses explicit JVM, Android AAR and KMP platform types with real sources and empty javadoc classifier jars; native source is added to native source jars.
Snapshot POM and SCM URLs point at the Prism repository snapshot; original SDK URLs are not required.
stagingRepository names ReleaseStaging and configures no Central service or tasks; stageSdkPublications collects all module publications.
Signing is mandatory in CI; skipSigning=true requires local OS-temporary staging outside CI. Keys remain in memory.

LICENSE/NOTICE resources use unique META-INF/prism-sdk/{sdk}/{module}/ paths in every module to avoid consumer merge collisions; the native KAP AAR includes the full Zstandard BSD notice under its module-specific path.

publicTasks.signing: signingInMemoryKey[/Id/Password] Gradle properties, or GPG_KEY_CONTENTS / SIGNING_KEY_ID / SIGNING_PASSWORD environment variables

integrity.coverage: Every payload file below this directory except PROVENANCE.json itself and generated build/cache directories.
integrity.recordedHeadHashes: sourceHeadSha256 and sourceHeadBlob identify committed upstream bytes; null means the path was not present in the recorded commit. sourceSha256 identifies captured local-origin bytes; sha256 identifies redistributed bytes.
